violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) ice machine scoop was observed inside the ice bin. Handle of scoop was touching the ice
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC MOVED THE ICE SCOOP TO THE BIN ON TOP OF THE MACHINE.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The faucet on the right side of the 3-compartment sink was observed with a non-functioning hot water valve. 3-compartment was observed with a functioning faucet on the left side.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO HAVE MAINTENANCE REPAIR THE FAUCET BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the 2024 Food Establishment Health Department permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGER TO CONTACT HER SUPERVISOR TO GET A COPY OF THE 2024 FOOD ESTABLISHMENT HEALTH DEPARTMENT PERMIT TO POST UP IN THE KITCHEN AREA BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) OBSERVED GREEN BEANS AT THE SERVICE LINE MEASURING 105F-119F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO REHEAT THE GREEN BEANS TO 165F.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) YOGURT CUPS STACKED AND SITTING ON TOP OF A COLD PLATE WERE MEASURED AT 45F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO KEEP A COLD PACK OR ICE IN A BAG ON TOP OF THE YOGURTS TO KEEP THEM AT 41F OR BELOW. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Air/Water Thermometers Accuracy, Degrees C & F
violations.observation: The ambient (air/water) temperature measuring device located in the following unit is not accurate: 1) PRECISION UNDER COUNTER HOT HOLDING UNIT THERMOMETER IS NOT ACCURATE AND NO THERMOMETER IS PROVIDED INSIDE THE UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: Ambient air and water temperature measuring devices that are scaled in Celsius or dually scaled in Celsius and Fahrenheit shall be designed to be easily readable and accurate to a +/-1.5 degrees C in the intended range of use. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO EITHER HAVE THE THERMOMETER ON THE HOT HOLDING UNIT REPAIRED OR PROVIDE AN AMBIENT AIR THERMOMETER INSIDE THE UNIT. THE HOT HOLDING UNIT SHALL ACHIEVE AN AMBIENT AIR TEMPERATURE ABOVE 165F TO KEEP HOT FOODS AT 135F OR ABOVE AT ALL TIMES. ENSURE CORRECTION WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Food Thermometer, Repair and Calibration
violations.observation: The metal stemmed dial food thermometer was measured at 26f in the ice water bath.
violations.corrective_action: Food thermometers shall be calibrated in accordance with manufacturer's specifications as necessary to ensure their accuracy. It is suggested that food thermometers be calibrated at least once a week in a cup completely filled with ice and cold water to a temperature of 32F or calibrated in a pot of boiling water at 212F. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO ENSURE IT IS CALIBRATED TO 32F IN THE ICE WATER BATH BEFORE USING TO MEASURE FOOD TEMPERATURES. EHS ALSO COMMENTED THAT THE DIGITAL FOOD THERMOMETER IS MEASURING 30.3F WHICH IS BORDER LINE FOR ACCURACY. ENSURE THERMOMETERS ARE ACCURATE AND CALIBRATED AS OFTEN AS NEEDED.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): 1) ELEVATE FOOD OFF THE FLOOR INSIDE THE WALK-IN FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO RETURN THE MILK CRATES AND PROVIDE EITHER MORE SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS INSIDE THE FREEZER BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Outside Receptacle, Tight Fitting Lids
violations.observation: Observed both the recycling bin lid(s) and dumpster lid(s) open.
violations.corrective_action: Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered with tight fitting lids or doors if kept outside the food establishment. EHS DISCUSSED WITH THE MANAGER AND CUSTODIAL STAFF THAT THE LIDS AND/OR DOORS SHALL REMAIN CLOSED AT ALL TIMES UNLESS ACTIVELY DISPOSING OF RECYCLABLES AND TRASH. ENSURE CORRECTION TODAY.
